findings.evidence: `def chiralCoupling (t3 q s2 : ℝ) : ℝ := t3 - q * s2` (line 73); grep of the file shows `chiralCoupling_zero_zero` has no use site, and the only other `chiralCoupling` lemma is `chiralCoupling_def`.
findings.fix: Replace it with the two general forms, e.g. `@[simp] chiralCoupling_zero_left (q s2 : ℝ) : chiralCoupling 0 q s2 = -(q * s2)` and `@[simp] chiralCoupling_charge_zero (t3 s2 : ℝ) : chiralCoupling t3 0 s2 = t3`; the present statement follows from either by `simp`.
findings.issue: `chiralCoupling_zero_zero : chiralCoupling 0 0 s2 = 0` is a `@[simp]` lemma at the intersection of two degeneracies, unused anywhere, and strictly weaker than the natural lemmas. Meanwhile `chiralCoupling 0 q s2` — the right-handed coupling that `ofQuantumNumbers_gR` (line 160) and `eq_ofQuantumNumbers_iff` (line 169) leave in the goal, and that the module docstring advertises as `g_R = -Q sin²θ_W` (line 21) — has no evaluation lemma at all.

findings.evidence: Lines 196-233 give `doubletElectricCharge_standardModel_YQ_zero = 2/3` … `singletElectricCharge_standardModel_Ye = -1` as independent numerals; `singletElectricCharge_standardModel_Yu/Yd/Ye` appear nowhere else in the file or repo (grep for `singletElectricCharge` matches only `Couplings.lean` and `ElectricCharge.lean`).
findings.fix: Add the three equalities that actually carry the content, e.g. `doubletElectricCharge (standardModel.YQ : ℝ) 0 = singletElectricCharge (standardModel.Yu : ℝ)` and likewise `(YQ, 1)`/`Yd` and `(YL, 1)`/`Ye`, and derive the numeral lemmas from them (all three hold: 2/3, -1/3, -1).
findings.issue: The fact the PR relies on — that the doublet and singlet components of `u`, `d`, `e` carry the same charge, "which is what allows a single `Q` in `ofQuantumNumbers`" (lines 185-189) — is never stated; it has to be read off by comparing numerals across seven separate lemmas, and the three `singletElectricCharge_standardModel_*` lemmas are consequently unused.

summary: The core definitions and the bridge theorem sit at the natural level, but the only evaluation lemma for `chiralCoupling` is the doubly-degenerate `0 0` case, while the form the file's own simp set produces (`chiralCoupling 0 q s2`) has none; and the doublet/singlet charge agreement that licenses a single `Q` is left as seven separate numerals instead of being stated.
